title: 10 Signs a Godly Man's Humility Is Real, Not Performed
caption:
Deflecting a compliment isn't humility. It's discomfort wearing a costume. Real humility says thank you and lets it be true.

A man who already knows everything isn't humble, he's just quiet about his pride. Real humility asks the question instead.

The real test isn't hearing correction. It's not explaining it away after. Give the credit before anyone asks. Apologize without the "but."

Micah 6:8 never promised him the spotlight. Just the walk. Ten signs that separate the real thing from the performance.
